protocol.source_scope: 1979 public third-party NAV records, not complete independent official reconstruction
protocol.normalization: Hypothetical full annual budget=1; no investor account data
protocol.funding: Each year first NAV receives new budget. Startup Apr-Dec 2018=9/12, later years full budget including2026
protocol.annual_reset: New annual budget bought first, resets NAV and full fund-value anchors; cancels prior pending; no new signal that day
protocol.signal: Raw unit NAV relative to preceding actual trade; sale fraction of execution fund value; buy gross budget fraction of previous anchor value
protocol.cash: Zero interest; dividends cash, currently no events documented

fees.meaning: Static sensitivity, FIFO, execution date proxies confirmation

protocol.funding_cap: At EVERY date cumulative outside topup <=50% of cumulative regular annual budgets; no borrowing
protocol.primary_objective: Maximize full-history annualized TWR / MDD, subject CAGR>=max(0,annual40/30 CAGR), positive CAGR and funding cap
protocol.secondary_objective: Minimum MDD subject same return and funding constraints; show Pareto frontier and strict 40/30 dominance
protocol.tie_break: Rounded12decimal score, fewer actual tactical trades, lower extra, L1distance to40/30, lexicographic
protocol.chronological: FIRST optimize2018-2021 by same objective and in-period reference return floor, lock before full-grid computation; never reselect
protocol.validation_scope: Retrospective chronological diagnostics, not pristine unseen market history
protocol.robustness: Lag1/2/3; zero fees; complete calendar years2019-2025; public subscription opening2018-06-11; axial neighboring parameters
protocol.execution_limit: NAV observation dates proxy subscription dates; first2018 inception-date buys not proven open subscriptions
